title: Lift a throwing function into one that returns Optional

blocks.text: A `try`/`catch` block in the middle of a pipeline buries the pipeline. Wrapping it once in a small helper keeps each pipeline readable: `lift` turns a function that may throw into one that returns an `Optional`, empty when there is no result.
The file declares `CheckedFunction<T, R>`, whose method is `R apply(T t) throws Exception`. Write two static methods of `Lifting`:

items: `<T, R> Function<T, Optional<R>> lift(CheckedFunction<T, R> function)`: the returned function gives `Optional.of(result)`, or an empty `Optional` when `function` throws or has no result.
`List<Integer> parseAll(List<String> texts)`: the texts that parse as integers, parsed, in order, the rest skipped; `lift(Integer::parseInt)` is the natural way to build it.

blocks.text: "Throws" means any exception the interface allows, and "no result" has more than one form.

cases.says: parseAll keeps the numbers that parse, in order, and a lifted success is present.
A checked exception, not only an unchecked one, becomes an empty Optional.
A function that returns null gives an empty Optional, not a NullPointerException.

concepts: A helper that lifts a throwing function into one returning Optional keeps try and catch out of the pipeline.
